name: Jack Fruit
description: Fresh, naturally grown jackfruit directly from the farm — known for its rich aroma, sweet flavor, and multiple uses. This tropical fruit is packed with nutrients, high in fiber, and a great source of energy. Each jackfruit is handpicked at the right stage of ripeness to ensure perfect taste and quality. Ideal for eating fresh, making chips, curries, or even as a vegan meat alternative.

name: Mango
description: Fresh, naturally ripened mangoes grown on our farm with care and without harmful chemicals. Each mango is rich in sweetness, aroma, and vibrant flavor — a true taste of summer. Packed with vitamins A and C, these mangoes are perfect for eating fresh, making juices, pickles, or desserts. Handpicked at the right stage for the best taste and freshness.

name: Elephant Foot Yam ( ചേന )
description: This organic superfood is high in fiber, vitamins, and essential minerals, making it an excellent choice for a balanced diet. It supports digestion, boosts immunity, and promotes overall wellness. Known for its earthy taste and versatility, elephant foot yam is used in a variety of dishes such as curries, fries, and pickles.

name: Coconut
description: Fresh, farm-grown coconuts harvested with care to ensure rich taste and quality. Each coconut is filled with sweet water and thick, flavorful kernel — perfect for cooking, oil extraction, or direct consumption. Grown naturally without chemicals, our coconuts bring the authentic taste of Kerala’s farms straight to your home. Ideal for daily kitchen use, temple offerings, and traditional dishes.

name: Rice
description: Pure, farm-fresh rice cultivated with care using traditional and sustainable farming methods. Each grain is naturally grown and sun-dried to preserve its authentic aroma and flavor. Rich in carbohydrates and essential nutrients, our rice is ideal for everyday meals, biryanis, and traditional Kerala dishes. Free from artificial polishing and chemicals — bringing you the wholesome goodness of naturally grown rice straight from the farm.

name: Wheat
description:
**Wheat Description (for farmer’s product listing):**

Naturally grown **wheat** harvested fresh from our farm, rich in nutrition and taste. Each grain is packed with fiber, protein, and essential minerals, making it perfect for chapati, roti, bread, and other homemade dishes. Grown without harmful chemicals or pesticides, our wheat offers pure, natural goodness — ensuring health and quality in every grain.

name: Honey
description: Pure, natural honey collected directly from healthy bee colonies on our farm. It’s 100% unprocessed and free from any added sugar or preservatives — preserving its natural enzymes, aroma, and golden color. Rich in antioxidants and nutrients, this honey is perfect for daily use in tea, desserts, or as a natural sweetener. Experience the authentic taste of real farm honey — straight from the hive to your home.

name: Ginger
description: Fresh, aromatic ginger grown naturally on our farm without the use of harmful chemicals. Known for its strong flavor and medicinal properties, this ginger is perfect for cooking, tea, and Ayurvedic remedies. Each root is handpicked for freshness and quality — rich in antioxidants and essential oils that boost immunity and aid digestion. Bring home the pure, natural taste of farm-fresh ginger.

name: Red Chilli
description: Naturally sun-dried red chillies grown on our farm for bold flavor and rich color. These chillies add perfect heat and aroma to your curries, chutneys, and spice blends. Free from artificial color or chemicals, each batch is carefully handpicked and dried to preserve its natural spice and freshness. Ideal for home cooking or making your own chilli powder — pure, flavorful, and farm-fresh.

name: Cucumber
description: Fresh, crunchy cucumbers grown naturally on our farm without the use of harmful chemicals. Rich in water content and nutrients, they’re perfect for salads, juices, and cooling summer dishes. Each cucumber is handpicked daily to ensure crispness and freshness. A healthy, hydrating choice straight from the farm to your table.

name: Hen
description: Healthy, naturally raised hens grown in open farm conditions with proper care and nutrition. Our hens are fed with natural grains and free from harmful chemicals or growth boosters. They are strong, active, and ideal for both egg and meat production. Raised in a clean and healthy environment to ensure top quality and freshness — directly from our farm to you.

name: Milk
description: Fresh, pure farm milk collected daily from healthy, well-fed cows. Naturally rich in calcium, protein, and essential nutrients, it’s perfect for drinking, tea, coffee, and cooking. Our milk is free from preservatives, adulteration, and harmful additives — ensuring you get the authentic taste and nutrition of fresh farm milk, straight from the source to your home.

name: Rabbit
description: Healthy, farm-raised rabbits nurtured in a clean and natural environment with proper care and balanced feed. Known for their gentle nature and lean, protein-rich meat, our rabbits are ideal for both breeding and meat purposes. Grown without the use of harmful chemicals or artificial growth boosters ensuring natural health and quality, straight from the farm.

name: Dried Cow Dung
description: Natural dried cow dung collected from healthy, grass-fed cows and sun-dried to preserve its purity. Completely organic and chemical-free, it’s ideal for use as a natural fertilizer, soil conditioner, or traditional fuel. Rich in nutrients that enhance soil fertility and promote healthy plant growth — a sustainable, eco-friendly choice for farming and gardening.

name: Banana Leaf
description: Fresh, large banana leaves harvested directly from our farm. Naturally green, flexible, and aromatic, they are perfect for traditional meals, food wrapping, and festive occasions. Each leaf is handpicked and cleaned to ensure quality and freshness. Eco-friendly and completely biodegradable, banana leaves add an authentic touch to Kerala-style dining and celebrations.

name: Buffallo
description: Strong and healthy buffaloes raised naturally on our farm with proper nutrition and care. Known for their high milk yield and rich, creamy quality, our buffaloes are well-fed with natural fodder and kept in clean, stress-free conditions. Ideal for dairy farming or breeding purposes — ensuring quality, productivity, and good health straight from the farm.

name: Tapioca
description: Fresh, naturally grown tapioca (kappa) harvested directly from our farm. Known for its soft texture and rich taste, it’s a staple in many Kerala households. Packed with carbohydrates and essential nutrients, tapioca is perfect for boiling, frying, or making traditional dishes like kappa and fish curry. Grown without harmful chemicals — bringing you the authentic, farm-fresh taste of Kerala’s favorite root crop.

name: Cow
description: Healthy, well-nurtured cows raised naturally on our farm with clean surroundings and nutritious feed. Our cows are known for their high-quality milk, rich in cream and natural goodness. Free from artificial growth enhancers, they are cared for with traditional farming methods to ensure good health and productivity. Ideal for dairy farming, breeding, or organic milk production — pure, healthy, and farm-raised with care.

name: Cardamom
description:
**Cardamom Description (for farmer’s product listing):**

Premium quality **cardamom (elaichi)** grown in the cool high ranges and handpicked at the perfect stage of maturity. Known as the “Queen of Spices,” our cardamom pods are rich in aroma, flavor, and natural oils. Ideal for use in sweets, curries, tea, and traditional dishes. Naturally sun-dried and free from artificial coloring or chemicals — bringing you the pure, authentic taste of farm-fresh cardamom.

name: Goat
description: Healthy, farm-raised goats nurtured in a clean and natural environment with balanced feed and proper care. Our goats are strong, disease-free, and ideal for meat, breeding, or dairy purposes. Grown without the use of harmful chemicals or growth boosters, they ensure high-quality, nutritious produce — naturally raised for purity and health straight from the farm.

name: Duck
description: Healthy, free-range ducks raised naturally on our farm with clean water and nutritious feed. Known for their rich meat and high-quality eggs, our ducks are strong, active, and well cared for without the use of chemicals or growth enhancers. Ideal for egg, meat, or breeding purposes — delivering freshness, quality, and the authentic taste of farm-raised poultry.

name: Cow Manure
description: Natural cow manure collected from healthy, grass-fed cows and processed for use as an organic fertilizer. Rich in essential nutrients, it improves soil fertility, enhances crop growth, and promotes sustainable farming. Completely chemical-free and eco-friendly, our cow manure is perfect for gardens, farms, and plantations — bringing the natural goodness of farm-fresh compost straight to your soil.
